who: claude-opus-5-5 (Claude Opus 5.5), lane T2 (tokio out of ix-prof and blaze-explore)
what: blaze-core's Sim does not move its virtual clock to the deadline passed to `poll`: a machine whose only wait is its deadline never wakes under simulation, though the native driver wakes it. Every sans-IO machine has to arm an `Effect::Timer` for its deadline as well as report `deadline()`, which is the same fact said twice.
cost: reading sim.rs's poll and redesigning the serving core's timer (one armed timer, a NoRearm control) before any test could pass
cause: the two drivers disagree on what a poll's deadline means
workaround: arm an Effect::Timer at the machine's deadline and route its Fired completion back
fix: Sim::poll advances to the deadline it is given when nothing else is due, as native does; then the machines' timers go
